description: This 3D model depicts a stylized street lamp. It features a prominent blue rectangular top with a slightly rounded edge, resembling a housing for the light source. Below this is a slender purple pole, which appears to connect the top to a wider, cylindrical base also in purple. The very bottom of the pole transitions into a mint green cylindrical section, possibly representing the main light-emitting part or a decorative element. The overall design is simplified and geometric, with clean lines and solid colors, suggesting a modern or abstract interpretation of a street lamp. The simplicity of the form and the bright, contrasting colors make it stand out against the neutral gray background.
